The '''Bardotta system''', also known as the '''Bardottan system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]].
